title: The Parade Waits for Saturday

mood.label: Heavy going
mood.summary: Heavy going (39): a grey Thanksgiving of strikes over Sanaa and Riyadh, nuclear talk from Pyongyang, new US tariffs, and king tides that soaked San Francisco and pushed back New York's parade. Eased by Baidoa's falling famine risk and land returned near the first Thanksgiving.

lines: The sea came up the Embarcadero,
Sanaa shook while Riyadh watched the sky
fill up with someone else's moons.
Eight lie still beneath the water
in a mine that wouldn't drain,
and the toll on every crossing
went up ten, then twenty, again.
So set a place for the ones still waiting,
for land come home four hundred years on,
and so do we, till the grey is gone.
